extracted.intended_audience: Mac users or Canva users looking to download the Canva desktop app
extracted.subtask_description: Product landing page describing the Canva desktop application for Mac: how to obtain it, platform availability, and basic compatibility note (Intel and Apple chips).

rubrics_metrics.name: Download availability / Pricing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary call-to-action is to download Canva for free. The page also contains navigation to plans (Pro, Business, Enterprise, Education, Nonprofits) elsewhere on the site for users who need paid features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Also available on Windows, iOS, Android, and Chromebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which other platforms the Canva app supports in addition to the Mac desktop app.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mac compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Your favorite design tool available as a desktop app for Macs with Intel and Apple chips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the Mac architectures (Intel and Apple silicon) that the desktop app supports; users should ensure their device matches these requirements before downloading.
